data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add a re-runnable registry-refresh command that shares the normalize-and-sort library with the bootstrap, applies idempotent sort-dedup on write, and surfaces writer/reference pairs added since the last run.
**Why**: The bootstrap is one-time; without refresh the registry drifts from the codebase and the atomicity check misses new couplings.
**Scope**:
- IN: refresh command sourcing the shared normalize-and-sort library; idempotent sort-dedup on write; detection of pairs added since the last run; no-change re-run surfaces nothing.
- OUT: bootstrap discovery internals (draft-1); reviewer consumption.

## Done Definitions

- A refresh re-run on a fixture repo with exactly one newly-added writer/reference pair surfaces exactly that pair as an update candidate ← Satisfies: sc-7
- A refresh re-run on an unchanged fixture repo surfaces no update candidates ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The refresh command sources the shared normalize-and-sort registry library used by the bootstrap ← Validates Closure Check: "The shared normalize-and-sort registry library file exists and is sourced by both the bootstrap and refresh scripts."
- Writing the refreshed registry twice with no intervening change produces a byte-identical file (idempotent sort-dedup) ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Unit tests written and passing for the added-pair detection and idempotent-write logic ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations

- [Build] New .sh files set the executable bit (chmod +x) on creation.
- [Determinism] Reuse the shared library's sort-dedup so refresh and bootstrap emit identically-ordered registries; do not re-implement normalization.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a re-runnable registry-refresh command that detects newly-added writer/reference pairs, so that the registry does not go stale after the one-time bootstrap.
